title: pd~

flags.name: -ninsig <float>
flags.description: sets number of input audio channels (default 2)

flags.name: -noutsig <float>
flags.description: sets number of output audio channels (default 2)

flags.name: -sr <float>
flags.description: sets sample rate of subprocess (default pd's current)

flags.name: -fifo <float>
flags.description: sets number of blocks for round-trip (default 5)

flags.name: -pddir <symbol>
flags.description: sets Pd's directory (needed if different than default)

flags.name: -scheddir <symbol>
flags.description: sets scheduler's directory (also needed if different)

methods.description: start a new sub-process. This message takes startup flags and needs a pd file to open

body: [pd~] starts and manages a separate Pd process, which can run on another CPU core. It communicates with this one through audio channels and messages: 'pd~ start' with a patch name starts it, other messages are sent to objects in it, and its [stdout] objects send messages back. The -ninsig and -noutsig flags set the number of signal channels.
